title: Hot water.
officialText:
Hot water shall be provided to supply all of the hospital fixture, kitchen and laundry requirements. Special fixtures
and equipment shall have hot water supplied at a temperature specified by the manufacturer. The hot water system shall be installed
in accordance with Section PC 607.
